intro: Protect Kanati Greycloud is a Horde quest at Whitereach Post in Thousand Needles. Warned that centaur assassins have targeted the tauren Kanati Greycloud, adventurers must make a stand beside him and repel a squad of Galak assassins.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: But, there may be more centaur than I thought, I ask you, friend, to fight with me against these vile assassins.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank you for your help, friend. I couldn't have held them off without you.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
